description: Runs the Phase 15 worlds application's original services against a disposable PostgreSQL database, one process per actor.

createFolder.description: Check-then-insert of a folder; UNIQUE(owner, parent, name) NULLS DISTINCT.

createLabel.description: The same for labels; UNIQUE ... NULLS NOT DISTINCT.

startExport.description: Read the quota, test it, decrement it relatively, insert the job.

startExportAtomic.description: Decrement the quota only WHERE remaining > 0, then insert the job.
